messages.subject: SEM-Cov matrix not positive Definite
parts:
Hi all,

I am performing SEM on a set of binary data and i get the output but with a warning message like this.

Warning message:
In lavaan::lavaan(model = HS.model, data = sabdata, model.type = "cfa",  :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite; use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.

Also i have the correlation coefficients greater than 1 . What is causing this issue, and how do i fix this????. Please help mee

On 07/11/2014 09:14 AM, Avinash CH wrote:
> require(foreign)
> data<-read.spss("Datafile.sav",use.value.labels=FALSE,to.data.frame=TRUE)
> HS.model<-'f1 =~ A3B1+ A8B1
> f2 =~ A4B1+ A1B1
> f3 =~ A5B1+ A9B1
> f4 =~ A6B1+ A7B1
> f5 =~ A2B1
> f6 =~ A17B1+ A24B1+ A23B1+ A26B1+ A18B1+ A13B1+ A25B1+
> A31B1+ A27B1+ A14B1+ A30B1+ A21B1+ A20B1+ A19B1
> f7 =~ A28B1+ A15B1+ A22B1+ A16B1+ A29B1
> f8 =~ A33B1+ A34B1+ A32B1
> f9 =~ A11B1+ A12B1'
> fit<- cfa(HS.model,data=data)
> summary(fit,fit.measures=TRUE)
>
>
> I have a binary data(1/0)

Two things:

1) you need to declare your variables as categorical: see

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cat.html

2) remove f5: you can not have a factor with a single binary indicator.

Yves.
